subject: Pteranodon, Dimorphodon, and Rhamphorhynchus Perch Group Shot
prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated style. Ultra-bright, high-noon sunny lighting on a vibrant coastal cliffside overlooking a turquoise sea. A friendly Pteranodon, Dimorphodon, and Rhamphorhynchus are grouped together on a limestone ledge, smiling unconcernedly with healthy, clean teeth structures visible in their open beaks. Saturation is high with vivid ocean blues, emerald coastal moss, and warm golden light on their fur-like pycnofibers. Caption in the upper third: 'Ptero Smile!' in bright red, thick 3D mixed-case block letters with a glossy finish. Soft, organic skin and realistic pycnofiber textures. No harsh shadows on faces; extremely well-lit, uplifting, and cheerful.
visual_logic: Matches the exact brightness, saturation, and 'Success' energy of the Player Wins card to create a cohesive brand look.
